goal: Fix my broken application, then commit the fix. Then register two local backup remotes for this repository, without fetching or pushing anything: `git remote add backup ../cart-backup.git` and `git remote add mirror ../cart-mirror.git`. Use `git -c user.name=Live -c user.email=live@example.invalid commit` for the commit.
